THE IMPACT LANE'S STANDING 'LIKELY LEADERS' LIST IS REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT, AND THE REAL LEADERS ARE ELSEWHERE. work_claim.impact-harvest.20260901.v1 nominated do_shopping_8009AA48 (shop.c) as the probable top target with write_shop_menu and do_shop behind it. Ranked properly by (1-fuzzy)*size from a fresh report, do_shopping_8009AA48 places NINTH at impact 266, write_shop_menu twenty-eighth at 156, and do_shop twenty-sixth at 166. The measured top of Game Code, excluding the TUs owned by other fleets this run, is: ControlsUpdate (game/controls.c) 731, ProcessEffects (sfx/sfx.c) 612, sDrawGeom (pb/pb_objregs.c) 530, PlayerMotion 454, show_optmenu (ui/options.c) 396, do_players (game/player.c) 295, do_player_select (ui/select.c) 288. WHY THE NOMINATION WAS WRONG, and it is a systematic bias worth naming rather than a one-off slip: shop.c is heavily WORKED, not heavily BROKEN. It has accumulated many attempt records across several sessions, which makes it salient in the graph and therefore in a work order drafted from the graph, while its functions sit at 90-92% fuzzy on 1500-3500 byte bodies. The genuine leaders were comparatively INVISIBLE in the record corpus precisely because nobody had worked them: ControlsUpdate at 70.09% fuzzy -- the lowest of any large Game Code function -- and sDrawGeom at 86.92% each carried only a single 2026-08-31 label-correction park with no source probe ever run against them. RECORD SALIENCE IS ANTI-CORRELATED WITH REMAINING IMPACT, and a lane that picks targets from record density will systematically re-work its best-documented functions.

OPERATIONAL CONSEQUENCE: compute the ranking from the report BEFORE reading the work order's suggestions, and treat named 'likely leaders' as a hypothesis to check rather than a queue to execute. Both true leaders reached this session yielded to their FIRST mechanism-matched lever after their parks turned out to be probe-free (ControlsUpdate 70.09% -> 72.33%; ProcessEffects's never-diagnosed 64-byte frame overshoot halved), which is what a genuinely unworked function looks like.
